title: The night the light went out

facts.text: The Reader held Pip's lantern until it woke up again.
facts.page: You held Pip's lantern until it woke up again.

facts.text: Pip fetched his lantern from the edge himself, brave in the dark.
facts.page: Pip fetched his own lantern, brave in the dark.

facts.text: The Reader reached into the reeds for the lamp's wick.
Moth found the lamp's wick in the reeds.
Pip flew over the gap on a patched paper kite.
facts.page: You gave Pip a kite, and he flew over the gap.

facts.text: Moth carried a thread across the gap, and Pip hauled himself over.
facts.page: Your thread carried Pip over the gap.

facts.text: Pip crawled over the gap on a little wooden ladder.
facts.page: You gave Pip a ladder, and he crawled over the gap.

facts.text: Wick threw his rope across the gap.
facts.page: Wick threw Pip his rope across the gap.

facts.text: Pip lit the great lamp, and Wick called him keeper.
facts.page: Pip lit the great lamp, and Wick called him keeper.
